answer: AI agents managing a lagoon monitoring fund vote on sensor purchases with tokens locked for 30 days, and voting weight equals locked tokens, not identity count. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand hollow accounts still buys only 100 votes, even on a proposal to measure a zephyr. To control a majority, an attacker must acquire and lock more tokens than all honest voters combined, paying acquisition costs and losing access to that capital during the lock.
